第13章 家庭教师一
林笑脱离那个世界之后，便听到了系统熟悉的声音。
“世界1：黑篮。任务完成。获得系统奖励：操纵幻觉的能力。”
“完成随机任务获得自行选择下一个世界的能力，请选择。”
林笑考虑了一下，很快决定下来。“家教。”
“选择成功。世界2：家庭教师。主线任务：帮助泽田纲吉管理彭格列家族。”
“开始传送。”
林笑想着这个任务倒是看起来没有什么难度，本来泽田纲吉自己管理的也不错嘛，反正有reborn这个万能的老师在，能有什么事儿需要自己管？
所以自己就安安心心的做米虫就好啦~
可是，鄙人表示对林笑很痛心，这孩子难道还没有体会到剧情什么的，从来都没有正常过吗？
总之，让我们提前为亲爱的林笑同学默哀吧。
林笑在睁开眼睛之前，就感觉到了身边火辣辣的视线，让林笑颇为警惕了一把。
不过事实证明他想多了，趴在自己旁边的，是一个粉嫩粉嫩的小正太。
小正太有着柔软的暖棕色头发，白皙而有点婴儿肥的脸颊上带着健康的粉色，大大的眼睛一眨不眨的看着他，可爱的不行。
林笑天生对于可爱的东西没有抵抗力，瞬间被眼前的小孩俘获，萌的满眼桃心。
不过就在他想要逗逗他时，却无比惊悚的发现自己变成了一枚小豆丁。
愣了半天还没反应过来，就看到小孩摸摸他的额头，又摸了摸自己的，看起来很高兴。
“呐，小律，你已经不烧了呢。我去告诉妈妈。”
目送着小屁孩颠颠的跑出房间，正在想他看起来挺灵活的，就看到某小孩左脚踩上了右脚，啪叽一声趴在了地板上。
小孩看起来对于这种事已经习以为常，也不哭，拍拍衣服就又往外跑，然后再啪叽扑倒…

好吧。不用看系统给的记忆林笑也知道这个人是谁了…
当然就是我们这个世界的主角，还是小屁孩儿的废柴纲。
不过，其实看起来很可爱啊…总之，作为现在是纲吉的同胞弟弟的泽田律，他暗自下定决心，决不让任何人欺负他，自家哥哥，当然要收在羽翼之下了~
照照镜子看到一张与某纲如出一辙的脸，啊咧，双胞胎什么的，真是一种神奇的生物啊…
纲妈妈是一个很温柔的女性，不管是对已经看出废柴端倪的纲吉，还是显得成熟有礼貌的律，都非常好。这让两世都没有感受过母爱的律很是珍惜。
律当然也想过要显得更像一个小孩儿，但是————每当他一向到自己要装可爱或什么的，就不可抑制的嘴角抽搐。
他一个没有任何怪癖的正常青年实在是做不来啊…
于是——早熟就早熟，早熟的孩子有糖吃！
纲吉总是黏在他很边，明明是个小豆丁，却硬要拿出哥哥的样子。
抱住他将大脑袋在他身上蹭啊蹭。“最喜欢小律了！”
律是从来没有午睡的习惯的，于是当妈妈和阿纲睡着了以后，某律就偷溜出门在外面瞎溜达。
当他转到并盛公园的时候，竟然看到有几个孩子在围着什么叽叽喳喳。
出于好奇，律走过去想看看，结果刚一走进就听到他们在说什么，“你的性格这么奇怪，怪不得没有人和你玩儿…”“你看什么？反正你只有一个人，你想怎么样？”
暗自皱眉，这些人虽然还是孩子，但是怎么能这样说话？
而随后看到的景象让他目瞪口呆。
中间的孩子黑发黑眸，长得很精致，小小年纪就带着一脸冷漠的表情。手里拿着一副与目前的身高极不相称的双拐。
这难道是，云雀？！出来散个步也能碰上这种boss级的剧情人物，某律对自己的rp值有有了新的评估。
云雀对这几个人的话毫不在意，或者说压根就没有要搭理他们的意思，脸上带了一丝不耐，冷冷的道。
“群聚，咬杀！”
律迅速后退离这些人远远地，省的被当成一伙儿的给误伤了就不好了。

云雀收拾这几个半大孩子是绰绰有余，某律现在可不想主动上去招惹，万一人家一个不高兴，自己可没有被咬杀的兴趣…
但是——他不想，并不代表就可以….
当听到那个机械的声音响起时，某律特别想找块儿豆腐拍死自己。我到底为什么不好好在家呆着非要跑出来啊！
“玩家触发随机任务，去云雀家吃晚饭。任务完成获得瞬间伤愈药丸一颗，失败奈奈和家光离婚。”
不得不说某系统的惩罚措施越来越有创意了…但是自己不能因此就不相信系统的强大，这种事情是绝对不能让它发生的…
所以，死就死吧！
硬着头皮挤出一抹看起来比较正常的笑容，律走向站在一片“挺尸”中的云雀。
顶着云雀那让他头皮发麻的冰冷视线，干笑道。“你好，我仰慕你很久了，我叫泽田律。”
（读者：这句话貌似有点眼熟？
某千：儿子啊，你搭讪的水平还真是有待提高…)
期望中的回应压根没有，云雀只是扫了他一眼，连咬杀都懒得做，直接无视了他。
好吧，某律无比郁闷的想着，自己早该想到了不是吗。
对于云雀，只能按照云雀的想法来行事啊。
云雀只对强大的人感兴趣，那么就用一下系统给的幻觉能力吧。
云雀的脚步倏地停了下来，明明是十二月的天气，面前的枯树枝上竟然以肉眼可见的速度绽放出色彩，转眼已是一树繁花。
这是怎么回事。
律用了瞬移眨眼间就到了云雀的面前，笑眼弯弯。
“呐，我想和你交朋友呢。”
看着瞬间来到他面前的泽田律，云雀的瞳孔微缩。淡淡道，“解释。”
律摇摇手指，像是突然想到了什么好主意的道。“我不想白白告诉你呢。这样好了，你请我去你家吃晚饭，我就告诉你这是怎么弄得，怎么样？”

律本来以为还得死缠烂打一阵子，但是出乎意料的，云雀连考虑都没有。“成交。”
于是直到律已经坐在了云雀家里时，才傻乎乎的反应过来。他竟然答应了？怎么会这么容易？不过话说，云雀家里真的很有钱啊…
看这充满古老韵味的日本传统建筑，他们家真是大的离谱啊。
啊，这难道就是传说中的————高、富、帅？
啧啧啧…
某律一点也不客气的询问着，“呐云雀君，你要请我吃什么？有没有三文鱼？”
（捂脸，这个吃货是谁，我不认识他..）
云雀还没开口，旁边的欧吉桑就很和蔼的开口了。
“律少爷想吃的话，我会吩咐厨房做的。毕竟是少爷第一次把朋友带回家来呢，看来您和少爷的关系很好呢。”
某律心虚的嘿嘿笑，赶紧说道，“没有啦，说来话长…总之麻烦您了。”
管家爷爷微微躬身，“律少爷不用客气。那么，我先告退了。”
目送管家离开后律才松了口气。云雀终于开口了。
“那么解释吧。”
律也不怕云雀会反悔，哦了一声道，“那是幻觉。”
见云雀在等下文，律也不好意思就这样就坑人家一顿饭，于是继续道。
“幻觉分为许多种，有视觉的、听觉的、触觉的、感官的，甚至是回忆也可以加以利用。如果意识不够坚定，就有可能会迷失自我。而且如果是在战斗中，可以利用幻觉来麻痹，或是拖延时间、转移注意力。”
见云雀皱眉，又道，“不过，只要心智、意志足够强大，幻觉就会无用了。”
没有打扰陷入思考的云雀，律只是安静的等待。
几分钟后，律听到了云雀的声音。“谢谢，对我很有帮助。”
赶紧摆摆手，“没关系没关系，这没什么的。”

大概是得到了有用的信息，云雀的脸色也不那么冷了，看起来稍稍柔和了一点。
等某律在云雀家享用了三文鱼盛宴后，拍着肚子的他才想起一个严重的事实。
糟糕了…忘了给奈奈妈妈和纲吉说一声了…
死。定。了！
作者有话要说：
亲们有没有猜到先出场的是云雀呐，少年啊正太啊什么的最有爱了

Chapter 13 Tutor 1
After Lin Xiao left that world, he heard the familiar voice of the system.
"World 1: Black Basket. Mission accomplished. Obtain system reward: the ability to manipulate illusions."
"Complete random tasks to gain the ability to choose the next world by yourself, please choose."
Lin Xiao thought about it and quickly decided. "Tutor."
"Choose success. World 2: Tutor. Main mission: Help Sawada Tsunayoshi manage the Vongola family."
"Start teleportation."
Lin Xiao thought that this task didn't seem to be difficult. Sawada Tsunayoshi himself managed it well. Anyway, with Reborn, an all-powerful teacher, what else could he need to take care of?
So just make rice bugs with peace of mind~
However, I feel very sad for Lin Xiao. Hasn't this child realized the plot and has never been normal?
In short, let us observe a moment of silence in advance for our dear classmate Lin Xiao.
Before Lin Xiao opened his eyes, he felt the burning gaze around him, which made Lin Xiao quite wary.
But it turned out that he had overthought it. Lying next to him was a young and tender young lady.
Little Shota has soft warm brown hair, fair and slightly baby-fat cheeks with a healthy pink color, and looks at him unblinkingly with her big eyes, so cute.
Lin Xiao was born with no resistance to cute things, and was instantly captured by the child in front of him, his eyes filled with cute hearts.
But just when he wanted to tease him, he was extremely horrified to find that he had turned into a small bean.
After being stunned for a long time before he could react, he saw the child touching his forehead and then his own, looking very happy.
"Hey, Xiaolu, your fever is gone. I'll tell mom."
Watching the little kid running out of the room, thinking that he looked quite flexible, he saw a child stepping on his left foot with his right foot and lying on the floor with a splat.
The child seemed to be used to this kind of thing and didn't cry. He patted his clothes and ran out again, and then fell down again...
Okay. Lin Xiao knew who this person was without looking at the memory given by the system...
Of course, he is the protagonist of our world, a loser Tsuna who is still a little kid.
However, he actually looks very cute... In short, as Ryu Sawada, who is now Tsunayoshi's younger brother, he has secretly made up his mind to never let anyone bully him. Of course, his brother must be taken under his wing~
I looked in the mirror and saw a face that was exactly the same as a certain one. Oh, twins, what a magical creature...
Tsuna's mother is a very gentle woman, and she is very kind to Tsuna, who has already seen the signs of a loser, and Ritsu, who seems mature and polite. This makes Ritsu, who has never felt maternal love in two lifetimes, cherish it very much.
Of course, Ritsu also wanted to look more like a child, but whenever he thought he was pretending to be cute or something, the corners of his mouth would twitch uncontrollably.
He really can't do it as a normal young man without any quirks...
So - if you mature early, you will mature early, and children who mature early will have candy!
Tsunayoshi always sticks to him. He is obviously a little kid, but he insists on acting like an older brother.
Hug him and rub your big head against him. "I like Xiaolu the most!"
Ritsu has never been in the habit of taking a nap, so after his mother and Gang fell asleep, Ritsu sneaked out and wandered around.
When he turned to Bingsheng Park, he saw several children chattering around something.
Out of curiosity, Lu walked over to take a look, but as soon as he walked in, he heard what they were saying, "You have such a strange personality, no wonder no one wants to play with you..." "What are you looking at? You are alone anyway, what do you want?"
Frowning secretly, although these people are still children, how can they talk like this?What he saw next left him stunned.
The child in the middle has black hair and black eyes. He is very delicate and has an indifferent expression even at a young age. In his hand was a pair of crutches that were extremely disproportionate to his current height.
Is this, Skylark? ! Even if you go for a walk, you can meet this kind of boss-level plot character. Youlu has a new evaluation of his RP value.
Yunque didn't care about what these people said, or in other words, he had no intention of paying attention to them at all. He said coldly with a hint of impatience on his face.
"Gather together, bite and kill!"
Lu quickly retreated and stayed away from these people, so as not to be accidentally injured by being mistaken as a group.
Yunque can take care of these half-grown children more than enough, but Moulu doesn't want to take the initiative to provoke them now. If they are unhappy, he has no interest in being bitten and killed...
But - just because he doesn't want to, doesn't mean he can...
When he heard the mechanical sound, Moulu wanted to find a piece of tofu and slap himself to death. Why on earth did I have to run out instead of staying at home!
"The player triggers a random mission and goes to Hibari's house for dinner. After completing the mission, he gets an instant healing pill. If he fails, Nana and Iemitsu divorce."
I have to say that the punitive measures of a certain system are becoming more and more creative... But I cannot stop believing in the power of the system because of this. This kind of thing must not be allowed to happen...
So, just die!
He forced out a normal-looking smile and walked towards Skylark, who was standing among the corpses.
He laughed dryly despite Skylark's cold gaze that made his scalp numb. "Hello, I have admired you for a long time. My name is Sawada Ritsu."
(Reader: This sentence seems familiar?
A Qian: My son, your conversation skills really need to be improved...)
There was no response at all. Skylark just glanced at him, not even bothering to bite him, and just ignored him.
Well, Moulu thought in great depression, he should have thought of it a long time ago, right?
For Skylark, you can only act according to Skylark's ideas.
Skylark is only interested in powerful people, so let's use the illusion ability given by the system.
Skylark's footsteps suddenly stopped. It was clearly December weather, but the dead branches in front of him were blooming with colors at a speed visible to the naked eye. In the blink of an eye, the tree was full of flowers.
What's going on.
Ritsu used teleportation and was in front of Skylark in the blink of an eye, smiling eyes.
"Hey, I want to make friends with you."
Looking at Ritsu Sawada who came to him instantly, Hibari's pupils narrowed. He said calmly, "Explain."
Lu shook her finger, as if she suddenly thought of a good idea. "I don't want to tell you in vain. How about you invite me to your house for dinner and I'll tell you how it happened?"
Ritsu originally thought he would have to stalk her for a while, but to his surprise, Hibari didn't even think about it. "Deal."
So it wasn't until Ritsu was already sitting at Yunque's house that he reacted stupidly. He actually agreed? How could it be so easy? But having said that, Yunque's family is really rich...
Looking at this traditional Japanese architecture full of ancient charm, their home is really ridiculously big.
Ah, is this the legendary --- tall, rich and handsome?
Tsk tsk tsk…
Moulu asked without any politeness at all, "Hey Yunque-kun, what do you want to treat me to? Is there any salmon?"
(Face covering, who is this foodie? I don’t know him...)
Before Hibari could speak, Ogi-san next to him spoke kindly.
"If Master Lu wants to eat, I will ask the kitchen to cook it. After all, this is the first time Master Lu has brought a friend home. It seems that you and Master have a good relationship."
Moulu chuckled guiltily and said quickly, "No, it's a long story... Anyway, I'm sorry to bother you."
The housekeeper bowed slightly and said, "You're welcome, Master Lu. Then, I'll take my leave now."
HeadAfter sending the butler away, Lu breathed a sigh of relief. Hibari finally spoke.
"Then explain."
Ritsu was not afraid that Skylark would regret it, so he said with a sigh, "That's an illusion."
Seeing that Hibari was waiting for someone to follow, Lu was embarrassed to cheat someone out of his meal, so he continued.
"There are many types of hallucinations, including visual, auditory, tactile, sensory, and even memories. If the consciousness is not firm enough, you may lose yourself. And if you are in battle, you can use hallucinations to paralyze, delay time, or divert attention."
Seeing Skylark frowning, he added, "However, as long as the mind and will are strong enough, illusions will be useless."
Without disturbing Skylark who was deep in thought, Ritsu just waited quietly.
A few minutes later, Ritsu heard Hibari's voice. "Thank you, it was very helpful to me."
He quickly waved his hand and said, "It's okay, it's okay, it's nothing."
Probably because he got useful information, Skylark's face became less cold and looked a little softer.
After Molu enjoyed a salmon feast at Yunque's house, he patted his belly and remembered a serious fact.
Oops...I forgot to tell Nana's mother and Tsunayoshi...
die. Certainly. Got it!
The author has something to say:
Did you guys guess that Hibari appeared first? The boy, shota, etc. are the most adorable.
